reports.title: BD Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year Fiscal 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Full Year Fiscal 2027 Guidance
section: The company provides the following guidance with respect to fiscal 2027.

GAAP Revenue Growth | Low single-digit
Revenue Growth (FXN) | Low single-digit
Adjusted Diluted EPS | $13.10 to $13.30

BD's guidance for full year fiscal 2027 reflects numerous assumptions that could affect its business, based on the information management has reviewed as of this date. Management will discuss its guidance and several of its assumptions on its fourth fiscal quarter earnings call.
